en_title: Gorakhpur Proposes Rs 4.14 Crore Electric Crematorium at Rajghat
en_seo_title: Gorakhpur Proposes Rs 4.14 Crore Electric Crematorium at Rajghat
en_body: Gorakhpur Municipal Corporation has proposed a new electric crematorium at Rajghat on the Rapti riverbank. According to reporting dated November 13, 2026, the estimated Rs 4.14 crore proposal has been forwarded to the Uttar Pradesh government under the Mukhyamantri Vaishvik Nagarodaya Yojana. The proposal includes two electric furnaces, intended to reduce the need for firewood and limit air pollution associated with traditional cremation methods. Existing cremation facilities at Rajghat have reportedly been affected by nearby bridge construction and remained unavailable for an extended period. A committee headed by Mayor Dr Manglesh Srivastava approved forwarding the plan for consideration. The project remains a proposal, not a completed or operational facility. State approval, funding and construction arrangements would be required before residents could use the new service.
